quotes.q0: Clarity saves founding teams more energy later than speed at the wrong point.
quotes.q1: Not every tension is a problem. But every unresolved tension costs focus.
quotes.q2: Good founder teams don't look frictionless. They address friction early.
quotes.q3: Similar or different – what matters is what you agree on.
quotes.q4: Sometimes the most productive progress is not another task, but a better agreement.
quotes.q5: A good question at the right time often saves a long discussion.
quotes.q6: Saying early what matters to you makes it easier for others to listen.
quotes.q7: Agreements are not contracts against each other, but orientation for each other.
quotes.q8: An open point that is spoken out weighs less than one that quietly runs along.
quotes.q9: Founding together also means deciding together how you decide.
